INPUT Root

    CREATE Empty Queue
    ENQUEUE Root

    WHILE Queue is not empty
        Node <- DEQUEUE Queue
        OUTPUT Node.Value

        IF Node.Left exists THEN
            ENQUEUE Node.Left
        ENDIF

        IF Node.Right exists THEN
            ENQUEUE Node.Right
        ENDIF
    ENDWHILE
END
